text:
{collection}.{field}: {type_id} cannot be personal.
Only basic values can be personal: nc.string, nc.int, nc.float, nc.boolean and nc.oneOf.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses a model that breaks a rule on its own: a field of a type that cannot be personal is marked personal. Opening with such a lock shows it after error.lockInvalid's colon.
